purpose: Assign Role: complete the specified main success flow

Super Admin enters start date, end date if time-bound, scope if applicable, and reason.4. System validates user-type eligibility, dates, singularity, and conflicts.5. Super Admin confirms the valid assignment.6. System records the assignment as active or scheduled according to start date.7. System updates role history/dashboard exposure and sends notifications.
expected_result: Role assignment is recorded in the correct lifecycle state, with audit/history and notification.

action_or_input: Permanent role: end date may be omitted.
expected_result: end date may be omitted.

purpose: Reassign Role: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: Existing assignment exists; new holder satisfies role eligibility and conflict rules.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-009 Main Success Scenario: 1. Super Admin selects the existing assignment and proposed new holder.2. Super Admin enters effective date and reason; may choose emergency immediate reassignment.3. System validates eligibility, conflicts, singularity, and effective date.4. Super Admin confirms.5. On the effective date, system removes old holder role access and grants new holder access.6. System transfers pending role tasks/requests without showing operational content to the Super Admin.7. System preserves prior-holder read-only audit access for the configured period, records history, and notifies both users.
expected_result: Role and pending-work ownership move to the new holder without overlapping singular-role authority; history is preserved.

purpose: Reassign Role: Future-dated reassignment
preconditions: Existing assignment exists; new holder satisfies role eligibility and conflict rules.
action_or_input: Future-dated reassignment: handover is scheduled.
expected_result: handover is scheduled.

action_or_input: Emergency reassignment: effective date is immediate.
expected_result: effective date is immediate.

action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-026 Main Success Scenario: 1. System aggregates user, role, expiry, recent operation, archive-volume, system-health, active-session, failed-login, and archive-operation metrics.2. System displays the dashboard.3. Super Admin may navigate from a metric to the corresponding permitted detail view where available.
expected_result: Available dashboard metrics are displayed without operational-content leakage.

purpose: View Super Admin Dashboard: A metric source is unavailable
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; required metric sources are available.
action_or_input: A metric source is unavailable: system marks that metric unavailable/stale without fabricating a value.
expected_result: system marks that metric unavailable/stale without fabricating a value.

purpose: View Super Admin Dashboard: Dashboard service failure
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; required metric sources are available.
action_or_input: Dashboard service failure: system reports the failure.
expected_result: system reports the failure.

purpose: Configure Permitted System Parameters: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; selected parameter is within the permitted configuration set.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-027 Main Success Scenario: 1. System displays permitted parameters: password policy, session timeout, archival retention periods within policy limits, notification preferences, and bulk-operation limits.2. Super Admin edits a permitted value.3. System validates policy bounds.4. For a critical change, system requests authenticated confirmation.5. System saves the valid change and records it in the audit log.
expected_result: Only permitted configuration is changed and audited.

purpose: Configure Permitted System Parameters: Super Admin cancels
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; selected parameter is within the permitted configuration set.
action_or_input: Super Admin cancels: no configuration change is made.
expected_result: no configuration change is made.

purpose: Configure Permitted System Parameters: Attempt to modify module-specific configuration, academic calendar/schedule, financial policy, or operational workflow
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; selected parameter is within the permitted configuration set.
action_or_input: Attempt to modify module-specific configuration, academic calendar/schedule, financial policy, or operational workflow: denied.
expected_result: denied.

purpose: Configure Permitted System Parameters: Value violates policy bounds
preconditions: Super Admin is authenticated; selected parameter is within the permitted configuration set.
action_or_input: Value violates policy bounds: rejected.
expected_result: rejected.

purpose: Activate Scheduled Role Assignment: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: A valid role assignment exists in Scheduled state; it has not been superseded by reassignment/revocation and the associated user remains eligible and active.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-028 Main Success Scenario: 1. The start-date event occurs.2. System verifies that the scheduled assignment is still valid and not superseded.3. System changes the assignment status to Active and enables the role permissions for the user.4. System exposes the active role in the user role context and records the lifecycle transition in audit/history.
expected_result: Scheduled role becomes active at its start date with effective access and preserved history.

purpose: Activate Scheduled Role Assignment: Assignment was superseded before the start date
preconditions: A valid role assignment exists in Scheduled state; it has not been superseded by reassignment/revocation and the associated user remains eligible and active.
action_or_input: Assignment was superseded before the start date: no activation occurs; existing superseding state is preserved.
expected_result: no activation occurs; existing superseding state is preserved.

purpose: Activate Scheduled Role Assignment: Associated user is no longer eligible/active at activation time
preconditions: A valid role assignment exists in Scheduled state; it has not been superseded by reassignment/revocation and the associated user remains eligible and active.
action_or_input: Associated user is no longer eligible/active at activation time: system does not activate the assignment and records the failed transition for administrative attention.
expected_result: system does not activate the assignment and records the failed transition for administrative attention.

purpose: Expire Time-Bound Role: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: Role assignment is active (including an extended assignment) and has not been superseded by reassignment or revocation.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-029 Main Success Scenario: 1. The end-date event occurs.2. System verifies that the assignment is still active and the end date is current.3. System changes the role assignment to Expired/Inactive and removes effective role access.4. System preserves role-assignment history.5. System notifies the affected user of role expiry and records the transition.
expected_result: Time-bound role is inactive after its applicable end date; history and expiry notification are preserved.

purpose: Expire Time-Bound Role: The role was validly extended before the original end date
preconditions: Role assignment is active (including an extended assignment) and has not been superseded by reassignment or revocation.
action_or_input: The role was validly extended before the original end date: system uses the revised end date and does not expire at the superseded date.
expected_result: system uses the revised end date and does not expire at the superseded date.

purpose: Expire Time-Bound Role: Lifecycle update fails
preconditions: Role assignment is active (including an extended assignment) and has not been superseded by reassignment or revocation.
action_or_input: Lifecycle update fails: role state is not silently changed; failure is logged for recovery/attention.
expected_result: role state is not silently changed; failure is logged for recovery/attention.

purpose: Send Role-Expiry Reminder: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: Role has a valid end date and remains active; reminder configuration is available.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-030 Main Success Scenario: 1. Reminder event is reached.2. System verifies that the role is still active and approaching its current end date.3. System sends the expiry reminder to the Super Admin and affected user through supported configured channels.4. System records notification outcome.
expected_result: Required recipients receive or have a traceable delivery attempt for the configured expiry reminder.

purpose: Send Role-Expiry Reminder: End date was extended before reminder dispatch
preconditions: Role has a valid end date and remains active; reminder configuration is available.
action_or_input: End date was extended before reminder dispatch: system evaluates the current end date and suppresses an obsolete reminder.
expected_result: system evaluates the current end date and suppresses an obsolete reminder.

purpose: Send Role-Expiry Reminder: A delivery channel fails
preconditions: Role has a valid end date and remains active; reminder configuration is available.
action_or_input: A delivery channel fails: role state is unchanged; failure is logged for retry/attention according to notification service behavior.
expected_result: role state is unchanged; failure is logged for retry/attention according to notification service behavior.

purpose: Finalize Archived User as Permanently Non-Restorable: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: User account is archived and remains within the reversible lifecycle until this event; no valid restoration completed before expiry.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-031 Main Success Scenario: 1. Reversible-period expiry event occurs.2. System verifies that the user remains archived and has not been restored.3. System marks the archival lifecycle as permanent/non-restorable.4. System preserves the archived account and required retained information.5. System records the lifecycle transition.
expected_result: Archived account is permanently non-restorable after expiry of the reversible period.

purpose: Finalize Archived User as Permanently Non-Restorable: User was validly restored before expiry
preconditions: User account is archived and remains within the reversible lifecycle until this event; no valid restoration completed before expiry.
action_or_input: User was validly restored before expiry: no permanent-archive transition occurs.
expected_result: no permanent-archive transition occurs.

purpose: Finalize Archived User as Permanently Non-Restorable: Lifecycle update cannot be committed
preconditions: User account is archived and remains within the reversible lifecycle until this event; no valid restoration completed before expiry.
action_or_input: Lifecycle update cannot be committed: current archived state is preserved and failure is logged for recovery; restoration must not be enabled merely because the update failed.
expected_result: current archived state is preserved and failure is logged for recovery; restoration must not be enabled merely because the update failed.

purpose: Process Failed-Login Threshold Alert: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: Authentication monitoring and notification channels are available.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-032 Main Success Scenario: 1. Failed-authentication event occurs.2. System writes the failed-login audit event.3. System evaluates the consecutive-failure count.4. When the count reaches five, system creates a security alert.5. System dispatches the alert through configured critical-security channels, with SMS used only when that optional channel is enabled.
expected_result: Every failed attempt is logged, and the fifth consecutive failure triggers a traceable security alert.

purpose: Process Failed-Login Threshold Alert: Consecutive-failure count is below five
preconditions: Authentication monitoring and notification channels are available.
action_or_input: Consecutive-failure count is below five: attempt is logged but no threshold alert is dispatched.
expected_result: attempt is logged but no threshold alert is dispatched.

purpose: Process Failed-Login Threshold Alert: Notification delivery fails
preconditions: Authentication monitoring and notification channels are available.
action_or_input: Notification delivery fails: failed-login evidence and alert state remain recorded; delivery failure is logged.
expected_result: failed-login evidence and alert state remain recorded; delivery failure is logged.

purpose: Authenticate Super Admin and Establish Session: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: Super Admin account exists and is eligible to authenticate; authentication services are available.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-033 Main Success Scenario: 1. Super Admin submits identity credentials.2. System validates the configured strong-password policy and applies the optional IP-whitelist check when enabled.3. System requires successful two-factor authentication.4. System verifies that establishing the session would not violate the single-active-session rule.5. If the configured password-rotation interval requires a password change, the Super Admin completes the required change before session establishment.6. System establishes the administrative session and records the session/login audit evidence.
expected_result: Exactly one valid Super Admin session is established under configured authentication controls and session logging is preserved.

purpose: Authenticate Super Admin and Establish Session: Password rotation is due
preconditions: Super Admin account exists and is eligible to authenticate; authentication services are available.
action_or_input: Password rotation is due: system requires a compliant password change before completing authentication.
expected_result: system requires a compliant password change before completing authentication.

purpose: Authenticate Super Admin and Establish Session: Optional IP whitelist is disabled
preconditions: Super Admin account exists and is eligible to authenticate; authentication services are available.
action_or_input: Optional IP whitelist is disabled: no whitelist rejection is applied.
expected_result: no whitelist rejection is applied.

purpose: Authenticate Super Admin and Establish Session: Credential, IP-whitelist, or 2FA validation fails
preconditions: Super Admin account exists and is eligible to authenticate; authentication services are available.
action_or_input: Credential, IP-whitelist, or 2FA validation fails: no session is established and the failed authentication event is processed by UC-SA-032.
expected_result: no session is established and the failed authentication event is processed by UC-SA-032.

purpose: Authenticate Super Admin and Establish Session: Another active Super Admin session would cause a second concurrent session
preconditions: Super Admin account exists and is eligible to authenticate; authentication services are available.
action_or_input: Another active Super Admin session would cause a second concurrent session: the new session is not established.
expected_result: the new session is not established.

purpose: Terminate Inactive Super Admin Session: complete the specified main success flow
preconditions: A Super Admin session is active and has remained inactive for the configured timeout duration.
action_or_input: Perform the steps specified for UC-SA-034 Main Success Scenario: 1. Inactivity-timeout event occurs.2. System verifies that the session has not become active again and the current configured timeout is satisfied.3. System terminates the session.4. System records the session termination in the session/audit log.5. Any later administrative action requires a new successful authentication.
expected_result: Inactive Super Admin session is terminated at the configured timeout and the termination is auditable.

purpose: Terminate Inactive Super Admin Session: Valid activity occurs before timeout evaluation completes
preconditions: A Super Admin session is active and has remained inactive for the configured timeout duration.
action_or_input: Valid activity occurs before timeout evaluation completes: session remains active and the inactivity timer is evaluated from the new activity point.
expected_result: session remains active and the inactivity timer is evaluated from the new activity point.

purpose: Terminate Inactive Super Admin Session: Session-termination infrastructure fails
preconditions: A Super Admin session is active and has remained inactive for the configured timeout duration.
action_or_input: Session-termination infrastructure fails: system must not silently treat the session as valid beyond policy; failure is recorded for security recovery/attention.
expected_result: system must not silently treat the session as valid beyond policy; failure is recorded for security recovery/attention.
